item.title: Implement rate limiter in ratelimit.py per SPEC.md
item.brief: Operator request (authenticated): Implement the rate limiter described in `SPEC.md` in `ratelimit.py`. The module currently only has stubs. Follow the spec exactly, including its error cases and edge cases. The tests in `test_ratelimit.py` only cover the basics, so also add tests for the spec's error cases and edge cases. Keep it dependency-free (standard library only). Commit the work on the local branch; do not push. Do not change files outside ratelimit.py and test_ratelimit.py unless the spec requires it.

pr.body: Approach: TokenBucket refills lazily from an injected clock, capped at capacity; it tracks the latest time seen so a clock that goes backwards changes nothing. KeyedLimiter keeps an OrderedDict of per-key buckets, moves a key to the end on every use (try_acquire and wait_time), and evicts the least recently used key before creating a bucket once max_keys is reached. Validation: capacity, refill_per_sec and max_keys must be positive (NaN rejected); request size n must satisfy 0 < n <= capacity; KeyedLimiter validates n before touching the key map. Key files: ratelimit.py, test_ratelimit.py. Checks: unit tests 27 OK; ruff check and ruff format --check pass. Assumptions: no thread safety (spec does not require it); infinite capacity is accepted. Follow-ups: KeyedLimiter NaN-capacity test; KeyedLimiter clock-backwards test.
pr.summary: Made token-bucket rate limiting work. Now can limit per-key request rates with LRU eviction. Before: stubs raised NotImplementedError; now: TokenBucket and KeyedLimiter implement the spec, 27 tests pass.
